evidence_states.processed: Underlying data were retrieved/decoded and a reproducible analysis output was generated.
evidence_states.browse_only: Visual reconnaissance preview; not a calibrated quantitative science array.
evidence_states.metadata_only: Catalogue/collection/granule metadata discovered; source science files were not downloaded and decoded.
evidence_states.reference_only: Published or institutional context is linked; not ingested as a machine-readable analysis layer.
evidence_states.planned: Integration or processing is designed but not yet executed/verified.
evidence_states.unavailable: An attempted public retrieval/processing failed or no suitable accessible item was found.
evidence_states.withheld_pending_qa: A field is withheld because source QA or interpretation is incomplete.
evidence_states.field_observed_unreviewed: Field observation was captured but has not passed independent review.
evidence_states.independently_reviewed: A named independent reviewer approved the observation for the stated scope.

sources.name: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 Public
sources.resolution: 30 m native product; current selected study areas include separate 30 m parent-area diagnostics and ~925 m common-support grids
sources.coverage: Ten curated Earth study/reference regions in current terrain product; GLO-30 public tile availability is not complete worldwide.
limitations: DSM includes surface objects; not bare-earth elevation.
30 m diagnostic is Earth-only and not a rover-scale safety measure.
The public GLO-30 tile set has unreleased tiles; do not use it as the global base layer.

sources.name: Copernicus DEM GLO-90
sources.resolution: 90 m nominal / 30 arc seconds; local metric grid resampled to ~925 m for candidate windows
sources.coverage: Worldwide land-tile inventory; oceans have no DEM tiles.
limitations: A global run is complete only when all inventory tiles are processed with no unreported failures.
Global terrain shortlist is coarser than local GLO-30 studies.
DSM is not bare-earth and does not measure geology or operational suitability.

sources.name: NASA POWER Climatology
sources.resolution: API grid / point climatology; not station observations
limitations: Not local weather-station data.
Air temperature is not surface temperature.
Precipitation is not water/ice resource abundance.

sources.name: Sentinel-2 L2A spectral context
sources.coverage: Ten selected Earth reference windows; inspect individual site result metadata
limitations: Spectral indices are screening signals, not mineral or brine classification.
Cloud and seasonal effects remain.

sources.name: Sentinel-2 true-colour quicklooks
sources.coverage: Quicklook products available for selected Pakistan windows
limitations: Browse imagery, not calibrated multispectral data.
Not field validation or geological classification.

sources.name: NASA Earthdata CMR MODIS and MERRA-2 catalogue discovery
sources.resolution: Not applicable until science arrays are downloaded
sources.coverage: Selected study boxes and global catalogue entries
limitations: Catalogue records only; underlying science arrays have not been downloaded/decoded by this integration.
A global MERRA-2 granule record is not a site-clipped environmental value.

sources.name: NASA DSCOVR EPIC
limitations: Global context only; not site-scale metric evidence.

sources.name: NASA LRO LOLA GDR
sources.resolution: 80 m native product; selected Shackleton grid aggregated to ~925 m
limitations: Elevation surface has interpolation; return counts are separate support evidence.
Not an illumination/PSR or ice-access map.

sources.name: NASA MGS MOLA MEGDR
sources.resolution: 64 pixels per degree; approximately 925 m near Nili Patera
limitations: Selected window has 50.53% observed-cell coverage; terrain summary is provisional.
Not rover safety or site selection.

sources.name: NASA Diviner polar resource products V2.0
limitations: Ice-depth fields remain withheld pending QA; no accessible-ice claim.
Historical model-derived summaries are not field measurements.

sources.name: NASADEM SRTM-derived elevation cross-check
sources.provider: NASA LP DAAC / Microsoft Planetary Computer
sources.resolution: 1 arc-second (~30 m at equator); resampled to ~925 m for matched regional descriptors
sources.coverage: Near-global land coverage: 60°N to 56°S; selected study sites outside this extent are not cross-checked.
limitations: NASADEM is primarily SRTM-derived with auxiliary ASTER GDEM and ICESat GLAS control/void-filling inputs; it is not a ground survey.
Coverage is 60°N to 56°S, so some high-latitude study areas are outside coverage.
NASADEM and Copernicus GLO-30 have different acquisition sensors, processing and DSM/DEM semantics; compare descriptors only.
This is independent raster-source checking, not in-situ field validation, geological validation or planetary analog validation.

sources.name: Pakistan Glacier Inventory prior work
limitations: Cited as prior work; ANALOG-X does not claim glacier discovery or remapping.

sources.name: SUPARCO / Space4Climate / DisasterWatch institutional context
limitations: No verified public machine-readable bulk ingestion endpoint or reuse licence claimed.

sources.name: NDMA hazard and glacier-lake institutional context
limitations: Linked as context only; no redistributable geospatial layers claimed as ingested.

sources.name: 10m Annual Land Use Land Cover (9-class) V2
sources.provider: Impact Observatory / Esri / Microsoft Planetary Computer
sources.data_type: Annual global land-cover classification derived from Sentinel-2; categorical classes
sources.resolution: 10 m native source; modal resampling to 30 m analysis grid within retained 5.55 km global terrain shortlist windows
sources.coverage: Global collection for 2017-2023; ANALOG-X enriches retained global terrain candidates only, not all global windows
limitations: Annual 2023 ML land-cover predictions are environmental context, not lithology, mineralogy, soil chemistry, brine or resource classification.
Provider-reported average accuracy is above 75%; accuracy varies by class and geography.
Source is Sentinel-2-derived; it is not a fully independent sensor family from Sentinel-2 imagery.
Land-cover data are processed for the retained global terrain shortlist only; this is not global per-pixel reprocessing of every candidate window.
No physical field validation is implied.

sources.name: NASA POWER global candidate climatology
sources.data_type: Gridded climatology at global shortlist coordinates
sources.resolution: Point climatology API / gridded product; not local station observations
sources.coverage: Top 100 retained global terrain candidates per planetary target, deduplicated by window ID; not all global scan windows
limitations: The enrichment is limited to the retained top-100-per-target shortlist and is not a global climate raster.
NASA POWER provides gridded climatology, not local field-station observations or current forecasts.
T2M is 2m air temperature, not surface/rock temperature; precipitation is not evidence of water/ice resources.
Wind and solar values describe terrestrial atmosphere/surface context and do not reproduce Moon/Mars environment physics.
